name: Wilder RSI(7) 30/70 reversal with 20-session time exit
author: ForexMT4Systems guide
instruments: liquid futures in the source test
entry_long: Enter long when RSI(7) crosses back above 30 after being below 30.
entry_short: Enter short when RSI(7) crosses back below 70 after being above 70.
exit: Close after 20 sessions; source rule is fixed-horizon.
filters: Signal only on threshold re-entry, not while RSI remains beyond threshold.
claimed_performance: The source reports historical test summary; no performance claim carried over.
implementation_notes: This differs from Connors RSI(2): Wilder RSI(7) threshold recrosses with fixed duration and no 200-day trend gate.
